high_level_description: The image is divided into two sections. The left section shows two individuals wearing military flight suits, standing next to a fighter jet. The person in the foreground is looking down at the aircraft, while the person behind him is standing with his hands on his hips, observing. Both individuals appear to be pilots or crew members of the aircraft. The right section of the image focuses on a close-up of a patch worn on one of the flight suits. The patch features an illustration of two bears: one holding a national flag and the other smashing a character resembling Winnie-the-Pooh.
